description: For fixed arithmetic terms \(s,t\) and a finite input-name assignment, the specified order-atom programs return accepted proofs of the actual closed numeral instances of \(s\le t\) or \(\neg(s\le t)\) on their respective truth branches, in PA models in the fixed ambient universe.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedProofs.orderPrograms {α : Type} [Fintype α]
  {r : ℕ} (name : α → Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program r)
  (s t : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term α) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedProofs.SignedPrograms
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leFormula s t) name
